reviews.rationale: Replaces delete (window as any).location and as-any reconstruction with scoped vi.stubGlobal; retains exact client options and HTTP properties. No wrong result enabled by those casts or observed leak is identified; other changes remove unused locals and rename.

reviews.defect: integration suite tests its own mock
reviews.rationale: Removes mocked openapi-fetch and path-routing mock; real factory now parses Response.json and substitutes IDs through fetch, with exact request count, method, URL and status checks. Old mock-specific null expectations become real-client undefined semantics.

Removes two wrapper.vm as unknown as casts while preserving active/open v-model state checks. Auto-unmount and first-element get are small incidental costs.

Types raw glob directly and scans Object.entries instead of keyed lookup; forbidden-import regex and offender equality checks are preserved. Single Record cast was not hiding a demonstrated wrong type.
Separates three public-class components into cases and removes as-object inference workarounds; same classes and existence assertions remain. Original short case had no gate defect.
